function.name: LOAD_IMAGE_PAL
function.param: Name of an archive of image
function.abstract: It recovers the palette of an image of disk detecting automatically his type by SDL_image.DLL

description.p: This function recovers of disk the palette of an image of 8 bits in any supported format by LOAD_IMAGE.

The function LOAD_IMAGE will load automatically the palette of the first graph of 8 bits that is recovered in the program. However, for programs that use more than a palette of colours, it is necessary to use LOAD_IMAGE_PAL for recovering the palette of colours or the images of 8 bits will not be shown correctly.
The function supports any registered format by LOAD_IMAGE (always that the images are of 8 bits and have palette of colours).

note.p: If the image uses a palette of less than 256 colours, only the first colours (0 - n) of the current palette will be modified.
